content:
Liam Dawson: FYI opened PR #4891 to update release notes + migration steps for the model catalog deprecation (redwood/gpt-lite -> redwood/core-std). Need docs + one tech review. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4891

Yuko Tanaka: assigning myself for docs review. Quick ask: can we include both Python and JS minimal migration snippets and a curl example? Ops wants a one-line changelog for release notes.

Ravi Singh: I'll do the tech review. Heads-up: the runtime team flagged that tokenization changes could affect few edge prompts; include a note and suggest pinning tokenizer_version if available.

CI Bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-4891--redwood-docs.netlify.app  Status: failed
Logs: 404 on /release-notes#model-catalog (broken anchor)

Liam Dawson: I see the anchor mismatch — in release-notes.md the header changed from "Model catalog changes" to "Model catalog updates". I'll fix the anchor and push a tiny wording change.

Yuko Tanaka: sample JS snippet (will add to migration.md):
```javascript
// JavaScript SDK: switch model id and preserve streaming behavior
import Redwood from 'redwood-js'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood/core-std', input: 'Generate release highlights' })
console.log(resp.output_text)
```
Also adding curl example for ops: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/core-std","input":"..."}'`

DocsBot: label 'release-note-required' added; label 'docs-review' added.

Ravi Singh: added comment about tokenizer note and a small code suggestion for batch calls. LGTM after docs adjustments.

Liam Dawson: pushed fixes: corrected anchor, added JS + curl examples, added migration note about tokenization and pinning tokenizer_version, added one-line changelog: "Deprecate redwood/gpt-lite; use redwood/core-std (see migration guide)"

CI Bot: New build triggered (commit f7c3b9). Preview: https://deploy-preview-4891--redwood-docs.netlify.app  Status: success \u2705

Yuko Tanaka: looks good. Small nit: in the JS snippet change `resp.output_text` to `resp.text` to match SDK v2 shape. I'll push a tiny commit.

i18n-bot: localization drop created for translations queue. Files: content/migration.md. ETA: 24h after merge.

Liam Dawson: schedule: need this merged by 07:50 PT tomorrow so infra can run smoke tests ahead of the 08:30 PT release. If CI flakes we'll do an authorized manual merge (requires two approvers in comments).

Ravi Singh: I'll add approval once Yuko's tiny fix is in. If CI fails again, I can +1 a manual merge but we'll note it in the release notes.

Yuko Tanaka: pushed fix for property name. PTAL.

CI Bot: Merge checks: 1 reviewer approval (Ravi Singh), docs review passed. CI all green.

Ravi Singh: approving now.

Liam Dawson: plan: Ravi will merge at 07:50 PT if CI stays green. If CI fails we'll call for manual merge as discussed. Thanks all.

Yuko Tanaka: thanks team :sparkles:
